description: Confirmed setup-time values for the Life OS agent. Jira site URL + MCP server name are provided; project keys are PRE-RESOLVED (see project_discovery.key_overrides, stamped 2026-08-02) and must NOT be re-derived from Jira at run time. Run ./scripts/lifeos-doctor.sh to verify config completeness + connectivity. This file is the single place the Jira config, skills, streak tracker, calendar, and persona workstreams read their runtime values from.

mcp.note: Jira MCP server 'atlassian' (sooperset/mcp-atlassian via uvx). Probe OK: 63 tools, jira_get_all_projects returned live data. Auth = API token.

project_discovery.method: Do NOT call get_all_projects / project discovery at run time. Project keys are pre-resolved live from Jira on 2026-08-02 and hardcoded in the key_overrides map below (source of truth). Use key_overrides directly for routing; never re-derive keys from Jira.

key_overrides.note: Resolved live from Jira 2026-08-02. BPD (Personal Development) exists but is unused by the 10-domain map (Nush/NSH added later).

projects.note: Pre-resolved : project keys live in project_discovery.key_overrides (stamped 2026-08-02). Not re-derived at run time.

events.name: Night-before mental prep
events.reminder_text: Tomorrow: X, Y. If you don't de-risk now (pack, message, phone call), you'll be scrambling — and it breaks delivery. 10 min.

events.name: Morning task-pick
events.reminder_text: Pick today's 1–3 from the week. Drift = carry-over + a broken delivery streak. Choose on purpose.

events.name: Unplanned-week warning
events.reminder_text: The week is empty and unplanned — that's the dangerous state. Groom now or you'll improvise reactively all week. Run weekly.

calendar.note: Google Calendar, local tz. Times: night-before 21:00, morning 08:00, unplanned-week Sunday 09:00. Static recurring, created once, NO calendar-write automation (FR-010). Reminders ONLY (FR-010a): the daily list is derived from the Todo-Week list in Jira at read time and surfaced in chat — NEVER written to any calendar event. See scripts/calendar-setup.md.

persona.note: One fixed coach voice applied to ALL surfaces (capture, weekly-groom, daily, research). Tune the single persona via 'adjustments' (add/blunt/soften/omit) from user feedback; do not create per-surface characters. Ragebait one-liners live separately in persona/ragebait.md (T016). See persona/persona.md (T039-T041).
